title: 传送与显形能量

source.prompt: TrackType: SFX. A finite eight-second retro fantasy teleportation energy texture. Continuous dense softly warbling electronic midrange buzz with filtered noise. Constant even amplitude and a clearly audible stable body from the very first instant until the end. No opening transient, no isolated event, no silence, no crescendo, no fade-in, no fade-out, no rhythm, no notes, no music, no voices. Designed to be stopped by a game animation after half a second or one second. Continuous stable sound-effect texture, immediate onset, no musical rhythm, no melody, no voice, no isolated repeated attack.
source.negative_prompt: music, melody, rhythm loop, vocals, speech, singing, choir, crowd, harsh distortion, clipping, long reverb, background noise, cinematic trailer

editing.method: manual-stop texture; preserve finite source semantics, 2ms onset/40ms natural stop smoothing

mastering.method: constant active-RMS gain with category peak ceiling
mastering.active_rms_comparison_method: 220-sample (approximately 5ms) stereo RMS windows; active=max(0.03*max_window_rms,-55dBFS), matching source baseline
mastering.basis: Preserve original relative levels: UI not louder in active RMS; ordinary impacts at most +2dB and magic +1dB; sustained textures capped at -23dBFS active RMS.

auditory_review_note: Objective signal/timing checks only; sound identity, absence of speech/music and subjective fatigue need listening.
